howItWorks.title: HOW IT WORKS
howItWorks.subtitle: The science behind sustained focus
howItWorks.caffeineText: Our 90mg of caffeine comes from guarana, a natural source. Because you eat it with protein and fibre instead of drinking it, it's absorbed more gradually than coffee or an energy drink, so you get a smooth lift instead of a spike and crash.
howItWorks.proteinText: 14g of protein and 2.6g of fibre slow digestion, so the energy from the caffeine comes on steadily instead of all at once.
howItWorks.releaseText: Protein and guarana together give you a flatter lift that lasts longer. Most people feel it within 20–30 minutes and stay focused for 3–5 hours, then taper off gradually.
howItWorks.glutenText: MOAR is gluten free under EU rules and made without GMOs. It contains milk and soy, and may contain peanuts and nuts.

faq.title: FREQUENTLY ASKED
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about MOAR Bar
faq.ctaText: We're happy to help. Reach out and we'll get back to you.
faq.q1: How much caffeine is in a MOAR bar?
faq.a1: Each bar contains 90mg of natural caffeine from guarana — roughly the same as a cup of coffee. Because it comes in a bar with protein and fibre, it's absorbed more gradually, so you get steady, focused energy rather than a sharp spike. No crash.
faq.q2: Can I eat more than one bar a day?
faq.a2: Yes — that's kind of the point. At 90mg per bar, you can have three across the day and land at 270mg total, which is well within the FDA's recommended limit of 400mg. Morning, midday, pre-workout: each bar fits cleanly into your routine without pushing you over.
faq.q3: How long does the energy last?
faq.a3: Most people feel the effect within 20–30 minutes and sustain it for 3–5 hours. Because the caffeine comes with protein and fibre, absorption is steadier than coffee or energy drinks — so the energy tapers off gradually instead of cutting out suddenly.
faq.q4: When's the best time to eat a MOAR bar?
faq.a4: 15–30 minutes before you need to be on. That means before a study session, before training, during a long drive, or as an afternoon pick-me-up. One rule: try not to eat it after 3pm if you're sensitive to caffeine — the half-life means it'll still be partly active at bedtime.
faq.q5: How does it compare to energy drinks?
faq.a5: Energy drinks give you caffeine and little else — often with a lot of sugar. A MOAR bar gives you 90mg natural caffeine, 14g protein and 2.6g fibre, with only 2g of sugar. It's food that works, not a drink engineered to taste like a science experiment.
faq.q6: When will I receive my order?
faq.a6: We're currently in pre-launch and taking waitlist signups. Once we ship, orders within Sweden will arrive within 2–4 business days. European shipping will follow shortly after launch — sign up to be the first to know when your country goes live.
faq.a7: MOAR contains caffeine (90mg per bar), so it's not recommended for children or pregnant women. It contains milk and soy, and may contain peanuts and nuts. It's sweetened with maltitol, and like other foods with sweeteners, eating a lot at once may have a laxative effect.
